$comment: Model aliases by intelligence tier, plus the permission reviewer's chain. Aliases cannot target other aliases, so every entry is a concrete model. Each tier spans claude-bridge and opencode-go so one exhausted subscription never empties it. A tier's lead is chosen for measured capability; the fallbacks behind it are ordered for turn-completion reliability, which is why they do not simply repeat the lead order. Lead capability follows Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 (read 2026-10-18): claude-opus-5-5 58, claude-sonnet-5-5 56, mimo-v2.6-pro 46, glm-5.3 45, kimi-k3 44, glm-5.3-flash 42, qwen3.8-flash 40, deepseek-v4.1-flash 39, mimo-v2.6-flash 38, kimi-k2.7-code 26. kimi-k3 and mimo-v2.6-pro both have documented tool-call repetition failure modes (kimi-code#3214, Xiaomi's own post-mortem), so neither leads any tier: kimi-k2.7-code survives above them in `top` on its 256k context and clean tool calling in this harness despite the weaker index score. OpenCode Go caps each model separately, so a cheaper model never funds a pricier one and no rung is placed to spend shared budget; a $15-cap model is not a hedge against a $60-cap one exhausting. claude-bridge serves `reviewer` only through the `pi-claude-bridge-index` and `pi-claude-bridge-standalone-prompt-capture` patches and `provider.allowExtensionSystemPrompts: true` in claude-bridge.json; without them it refuses prompts no pi session recorded. `reviewer` is ordered for latency and availability: Gemini and Groq free tiers and the opencode-go `-free` models still answer once the Go and Codex quotas are gone (verified 2026-10-04) and answer in 1–2s against Haiku's ~6s, so they lead (Groq gpt-oss-safeguard-20b first: 20/20 on the tricky set, 1.3s median), then Haiku, then the quota-bound models and Codex last. The two Groq models share one organization-level quota, so a Groq 429 takes out both at once; gpt-oss-20b was dropped because it shared that quota, added nothing the other two do not cover, and made a safety-relevant error (allowed `yadm restore pi/agent/*`). Gemini and the opencode-go free models are the independent pools. gpt-oss-safeguard-20b is gpt-oss fine-tuned to judge text against a policy you supply, which is exactly the reviewer's shape (gemini-3.5-flash-lite also 20/20; gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b 19/20; Haiku 19/20); it leads on accuracy despite gpt-oss-120b's marginally faster median, since its tail stayed inside the 30s first-event allowance (worst of 8 runs: 13.2s). its 30s first-event allowance covers claude-bridge Haiku, whose session startup averages ~10s with a tail past 15s.
